rows.title: collateral
rows.caption:
someone crashed their truck onto a wall. lots of people die and crash in this road daily, which is ironic because the highway itself is beautiful

taken by johnb

rows.title: depths
rows.caption: railing in a college building. they have this stair-looking holes spaced a few meters apart as part of its design. i essentially took a pic of that "hole" and copy-pasted it to look like a neverending abyss

rows.title: omen
rows.caption: last night on earth
rows.location: la playa de elena beach, macrohon

rows.title: leaving
rows.caption: my friend was driving through the mountains and the fog was so thick that every photo he took was already atmospheric

rows.title: refuge
rows.caption: nobody lives there. probably just used as a hangout spot. it still feels lonely regardless because of where it's placed

rows.title: reach
rows.caption: god is reaching down but maybe not for good reasons

rows.title: last flight
rows.caption:
it was raining at night. i went outside and there were literally 200 moths flocking near the light bulb in our shed

it took me around 10 minutes to fully get this right because they'd fly right in front of me

rows.title: peer into the void
rows.caption: an eye of a huge fish i found in the wet market. it was fresh and it was still pulsating. i kept staring at it, it was oddly haunting

rows.title: april
rows.caption: her friend took this. i just loved the muted greens and the framing too much not to work on it

rows.title: inhabited
rows.caption:
i was at a friend's sleepover but we were too alive to fall asleep, so we strolled around the neighborhood at 2am

we passed by a house that looks mysterious

rows.title: interim
rows.caption: it's a view of the main city just before you climb the stairs towards the shrine. 4:30am

rows.title: dusk
rows.caption: the moon just happened to align in a cell tower while the sky had a good gradient going

rows.title: between
rows.caption:
the paused rider mid-crossing,
the suspended bridge over water,
the perched bird on a wire between two points,
sky that's neither storm nor clear

rows.title: reclaim
rows.caption: i saw a stranger things edit on pinterest with this huge red object floating in an ocean. i liked how ominous and mysterious it felt so i recreated it

rows.title: cathedral
rows.caption: it's a bell tower from a church that's several decades old. the birds were pure luck, they fled the moment i took it

rows.title: birds on a feather
rows.caption:
birds always flock around the extension at 5pm, which is when i took this

the sky looked like this for maybe two minutes before turning completely dark

rows.title: procession
rows.caption:
shot during a parade for our school's intramurals. somebody was holding this banner up and the sun came through the fabric at exactly the right angle

the fleur-de-lis became a shadow

rows.title: seeping in
rows.caption: i was just finished cleaning the office. but when i turned back, the light outside was seeping through the door in a slightly cinematic way

rows.title: cellophane
rows.caption:
the dress is a trash bag and the headband is made with cellophane

it was for a friend's environmental awareness project to make an outfit based on recycled materials. it took them the whole day to prepare

rows.title: xed
rows.caption: the warmth will never reach him

rows.title: specimen
rows.caption: i hyped up my friend who took a chess competition in intramurals. it's unnerving how quiet that room was during the match

rows.title: dissolve
rows.caption: we were at a random beach and was about to head home. my niece was contemplating in the ocean. she was tired from swimming

rows.title: rish, beach
rows.caption: it was our culmination gathering held by our class. she asked me to take pics of her on the occasion

rows.title: fe
rows.caption:
the same class culmination event
her outfit and vibe was giving asian and the border leaned onto that

rows.title: prom
rows.caption: senior high prom. the chandelier was too good not to shoot

rows.title: they didn't make it
rows.caption: all the kittens died because she wasn't able to feed them. they died one by one in my friend's house. the mama cat then fled and never came back

rows.title: distancia
rows.caption:
my mom's side was having a beach reunion. i wasn't in the mood so i went uphill where the road was and just stayed in my uncle's motorcab
he had an audio system there and i remember playing acoustic songs to chill

rows.title: wait
rows.caption: my friend was falling in line in jolibee and it was like 5:30pm. she's the one in the silhouette

rows.title: floating hut
rows.caption:
my sister was pregnant and wanted to do walking exercises so i tagged along with her

the coast was recently revamped so there were new floating huts on the beach at the time

rows.title: depths (old)
rows.caption: the first version of the abyss. it was during the first friday mass and i was sitting on the second floor bored as hell

rows.title: ghosts
rows.caption:
4 of us went into a sleepover on halloween at a place with no internet so we just did random shit

we had sheets and sunglasses so we just went with it

rows.title: dappled
rows.caption:
this was in our room after a parade

she was my classmate. we were both band members. she does the baton. she's really good at it

rows.title: blue screen of death (real)
rows.caption:
the composition isn't the best, but i was so desperate to make this since i've sat with the idea for so long

i was just looking for anything resembling blue, and i was in the plaza overthinking where to take it while munching on my hotcakes. so i just took a pic of the city hall since it was right there

rows.title: shipwrecked
rows.caption:
i reunited with my friends from high school ever since we got seperated in quarantine. this was around new normal and we decided to hike little batanes

we had to pass by a neighborhood in this route. this boat statue was placed in the middle of a river

rows.title: pink sky
rows.caption: a discord friend was cursing the sun for making him suffer in 30 degree heat. he took this by mistake before pointing out the actual sun to blame on. but this was prettier

rows.title: stray
rows.caption: they're chilling on top of an ice box. there's fish and ice packets inside to preserve catches

rows.title: in a lull
rows.caption: my niece wanted a pic of her while submerged

rows.title: trajectory
rows.caption: my niece spotted the plane. the moon was there too so i just made it look like it was heading there

rows.title: faceless crowd
rows.caption:
i was high up in the stairs close to the guidance counselor's office. i tested out a long-exposure shot since everyone looked so busy

this was around attendance checking during intrams

rows.title: padre burgos
rows.caption:
our family kept travelling to bontoc to visit my sister ever since she left us after marriage

this one trip back home was at 4am. it was dark and it rained during the trip. we stopped at a bakeshop in padre burgos to eat something before continuing home

rows.title: sparks
rows.caption: i always liked looking at the sparks the grinder makes

rows.title: cj
rows.caption: plunged in the spring to take off the heat but we had to wait for 30 minutes just to head back home because there were barely any vehicles passing by

rows.title: together
rows.caption:
we have 2 stray cats and a dog as pets, they usually fight so this was rare

i lost the umbrella on the top-right

rows.title: windowsill
rows.caption: she's the keeper of the kitchen waiting for her next serving

rows.title: walk back
rows.caption:
was walking home after practicing yells for intrams

i was in love here

rows.caption: this was right after pabulhon ended. all the deco were still up without all the other noise

rows.title: kapre
rows.caption: was bored during a convocation so we were strolling around. there were rooms under construction that felt haunted. a friend roleplayed as the kapre, and another one suggested they touch hands to keep it lore-accurate

rows.title: little batanes
rows.caption: hiked with friends and someone else's family

rows.title: aftermath
rows.caption: remains of a storm that was never cleaned up. there's trash littered everywhere but there's still a strange sense of serenity

rows.title: suffocate
rows.caption: the only thing he controls is the smoke leaving his lungs

rows.caption: i was at a low point in my life and saw myself in a random flower. it's super dramatic but it was enough to project myself into something meaningless

rows.caption: the local chapel at a random night at 10pm

rows.title: end of the line
rows.caption:
found this on my way home
it smelled bad obviously

rows.title: lamp in a bush
rows.caption:
i was alone and was heading to a snack bar to eat but i just liked how nice a particular bush looked with the lamp on top

was fighting my social anxiety through this because i knew several people were looking at me

rows.title: after class
rows.caption: shot during recess, they were bored and hunched down on their phones

rows.title: head in the clouds
rows.caption:
i watched a double exposure tutorial for photoshop in youtube and just decided to try it out on my cousin

it looks like a poster for his funeral, but other than that i really liked it. i remember actually being proud for pulling this off

rows.title: moon
rows.caption:
this was my first ever moon photo taken with a canon 600d - the school camera

was surprised it didn't look like a dot like it does on my phone

rows.title: ghosts ii
rows.caption: same story but behind the chapel

rows.title: rish, prom
rows.caption:
gym floor was too loud and generic for how dressed up everyone was, so we slipped outside looking for another spot

i found this dusty staircase tucked near the entrance that felt like nobody used it in years. her friends caught up right after this

rows.title: dani
rows.caption:
she barely gets to visit. it was almost dark because we took too long to get here

you can smell the salty air and that weird 6pm humidity

rows.title: emman
rows.caption:
went to the plaza after a christmas party. we were both gifted a 1kg pack of pasta and spaghetti sauce. it's off-frame, but it was beside him the entire time

we had to bring it along every time we moved to different spots because there was so much deco in the plaza that year

rows.title: refract
rows.caption: the day i got caught cheating

rows.caption: cropped pic of a bird on a window perch then copy pasted it 4 times

rows.title: loiter
rows.caption: she owns the window

rows.title: tender
rows.caption: some nights leave marks on the walls. it's the kind of warmth you don't ask for

rows.title: airm
rows.caption: she stepped out of her own world for a second and got caught mid-joy

rows.title: underpass
rows.caption: the sea never gets in. something else does

rows.title: angel
rows.caption: still the same culmination thing. just realized how much photos i had with other people in that day. i just like the three women i took pictures with

rows.title: nocturne
rows.caption: the entire world has gone to sleep and you're the only one still looking

rows.title: do not block
rows.caption:
went to abuyog with my sister's family to watch my niece’s band competition. we walked to the town center to buy something cold to drink, and passed by this hallway on the way back

the red door and the framing possessed me so hard i had to walk back just to get a shot of it
i thought i wasted most of my life doing unremarkable things. but it turns out the ordinary days are what let the special ones exist at all

rows.title: vigil
rows.caption: standing still for hours until your fingers lock up. the tension is always in the hands

rows.title: standby
rows.caption:
tired legs on concrete,
the air felt heavy on the gym

rows.title: tether
rows.caption: holding on for dear life
